headline: Colombia's central bank reports rising inflation and economic moderation
summary: The Banco de la República reported that inflation increased during the third quarter, moving further from the 3% target. Economic growth has shown signs of moderation following the impact of a recent earthquake.
why: Central bank monetary policy reports provide critical insights into inflation trends and economic health, which dictate future interest rate decisions and currency valuation.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Rising inflation and economic moderation create conflicting pressures for central bank interest rate policy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The report highlights a divergence between rising inflation and slowing economic growth, which complicates the central bank's ability to manage interest rates.
